summary.boundary_score: ascending logical boundary bytes; ties use ascending configuration identity
summary.rank_correlation: Spearman average ranks; corr(-boundary_bytes,FPS), so positive means smaller boundary accompanies higher throughput
summary.aggregation: Equal weight across fixed nine classifier groups (or twelve detector groups). k_eff=min(max_native_trials,n). No aggregate over a reduced subset when a method lacks any group.
summary.budget_scope: Native trials in the evaluated group only. Generic acquisition, calibration training, compilation and quality evaluation are additional and excluded. Uniform-random values are exact expectations over all distinct subsets.
summary.calibrated_scope: Frozen published architecture-held-out predictions; no new fitting or extrapolation to the 17 quality-excluded classifier cuts or any detector.
